mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 950) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 235) indicates robust consumer demand and stable price levels, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 950 and CPIAUCSL < 235 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise exceeding 0.1 percentage points in one month signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 950 units indicate strong residential construction demand, reflecting healthy consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 950.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 indicates weakening manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), declining employment (PAYEMS < 135,000) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS < 135000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 950) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO < 95) indicates demand-supply imbalance where robust consumer demand outpaces supply constraints, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 950 and INDPRO < 95.
